We propose a novel pretraining strategy for VLN, which leverages the abundance of image text pairs from web scraped corpora to improve embodied perception in the VLN task.

we show that pretraining on large scale image text pairs from web crawled Conceptual Captions data significantly improves performance in Vision and Language Navigation, and that we demonstrate the positive synergistic effect of a pretraining curriculum that includes multiple stages.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to best leverage large scale web scraped image text pairs for improving embodied perception.
the following questions How can we leverage the abundance of image text pairs scraped from the web to improve the performance of embodied agents in vision and language tasks?
how to leverage the large amounts of vision and language data on the web to improve performance on embodied perception tasks such as Vision and Language Navigation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we have developed a novel method for leveraging the web for embodied AI.
the proposed method of leveraging image text data from the web for VLN pretraining is a significant step towards improving the embodied perception of AI agents.

we show that pretraining VNL BERT on image-text pairs from the web improves performance on the Vision and Language Navigation task, a relatively data starve perception task, outperforming the previous state of the art by a significant margin in the fully observed settings.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we demonstrate the value of pretraining visiolinguistic transformers on web scraped image text pairs for improving performance on embodied vision and language tasks.
VLN BERT is the first model that leverages large amounts of 'unembodied' vision and language data to improve the performance of embodied AI.
we show the potential of leveraging large scale vision and language data to improve the embodied perception task of Vision and Language Navigation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
pretraining on image text pairs scraped from the web can help improve embodied AI agents' visual language grounding abilities and their performance on downstream embodied navigation tasks.
pretraining visiolinguistic transformers on large scale web data can be used to improve embodied vision and language perception tasks.
pretraining visiolinguistic models on image text pairs scraped from the web is a promising approach for improving the generalization performance of embodied perception agents.
